decisions.reason: As a core sensing module that fits the firm's modular platform, it is still too early to judge fully and the option value of keeping it available is high relative to its likely carrying cost.
This industrial AC voltage input module fits the firm's automation customer base and its dedicated product-page presence suggests a stronger initial commitment and lower near-term abandonment risk.
A four-channel solid state relay module complements the firm's control and switching ecosystem, so keeping it on the market preserves a useful platform option while uncertainty is still resolving.

The server room monitoring sensor kit is more application-specific and therefore somewhat more exposed to pruning, but as a low-cost packaged solution it is still worth keeping while the firm learns about demand.
